aggressive_definition: Advanced prostate cancer; the abstract distinguishes advanced cases from organ-localized cases but does not provide more detailed staging criteria.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: During 16 years of follow-up, 913 men were newly diagnosed with prostate cancer; of whom 248 had advanced cases, 635 were organ-localized and 30 were of an undetermined stage.
study_design: Prospective cohort study within the Japan Public Health Center-based Prospective Study.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Subjects were 48,218 men aged 40-69 years who completed a questionnaire, which included their alcohol and smoking habits at baseline, and who were followed until the end of 2010.
reason: The cohort followed initially enrolled men for newly diagnosed prostate cancer and analyzed both total prostate cancer and stage-specific disease, including 248 advanced cases.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Alcohol consumption was dose-dependently associated with advanced prostate cancer [nondrinkers: reference, 0-150 g/week: hazard ratio (HR) = 1.23, 95% confidence interval (CI) = 0.83-1.82; 150-300 g/week: HR = 1.51, 95% CI = 1.04-2.19; ≥ 300 g/week: HR = 1.41, 95% CI = 0.97-2.05, p for trend = 0.02].
estimate_classifications.reason: The row matches the explicitly reported advanced prostate cancer estimate for consumption of at least 300 g/week compared with nondrinkers.
